summary.text: Ya Liu is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 21 in Wake County who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She served on the Cary Town Council from 2019 to 2023 and is the House Democratic Whip.

paragraphs.text: Liu lives in Cary, North Carolina, and earned two doctoral degrees, in sociology and law, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes work as a faculty member at Duke Law School and as the owner of a small business, and the General Assembly lists her occupation as small business owner and attorney.
Liu was elected to the Cary Town Council for District D, serving from 2019 to 2023, before succeeding Democrat Raymond Smith Jr. in the House.

She serves on the House Appropriations, Health, Housing and Development, and Judiciary 2 committees, the Appropriations Subcommittee on Health and Human Services, the House Select Committee on Involuntary Commitment and Public Safety, and the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Health and Human Services.
